info.title: Bosch Smart Home 2nd gen Camera API
info.description:
This description focuses on the JSON-based, REST-like API for the Eyes Cameras.
                
By using this documentation, the developer accepts and agrees to be bound by our [Terms and Conditions](https://github.com/BoschSmartHome/bosch-camera-api-docs#terms-and-conditions).
    
This documentation is subject to the [Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-NoDerivatives 4.0 International Public License](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-nd/4.0/legalcode).
    
Please report any issues you encounter with this documentation in our [GitHub tracker](https://github.com/BoschSmartHome/bosch-camera-api-docs/issues).

camera_host.description: The IP Address of your camera in your network

tags.description: Provides information about the camera's state

get.summary: Get pairing information to smart home system
get.description: Retrieves Smart Home system pairing information. States whether the camera is paired with a Smart Home system or not.

200.description: Successful Smart Home system pairing information response.

get.description: Returns the camera's current privacy mode state.
Retrieves the camera's current privacy mode status.
Retrieves the camera's current config privacy mode jingle status. Enabled by default for Eyes Indoor, disabled for Eyes Outdoor
Returns a valid response, when the camera's REST server has been started.
Retrieves the current firmware version of the camera.
Retrieves the camera's current acoustic intrusion alarm state.
Retrieves the camera's current visual intrusion alarm state.
Get the camera's current intrusion system configuration.
Get the intrusion system arming state.

200.description: Successfully fetched intrusion system arming state.

get.description: Get the camera's current intrusion system reminder configuration.

200.description: Successful intrusion system reminder configuration response.

get.description: Retrieves the camera's current alarm configuration.
Retrieves details about the camera's alarm status and related features.
Retrieves the virtual alarm zones defined for the camera.
Retrieves parameters that influence the behaviour of the intrusion detection.

get.summary: Get extrinsic calibration parameter of the camera
get.description: Retrieves extrinsic calibration parameter of the camera.

elevation.description: The elevation of the lens center, i.e., height over ground in meter.

get.description: Retrieves parameters that influence the behaviour of audio detection.
Retrieves the current speaker volume level.
Retrieves the current sound/noise level.
Retrieves the camera's current Streaming indicator configuration. When enabled, camera's status LED will flash while the camera is streaming video.
Retrieves the camera's current Icon LED configuration.

200.description: Successful icon led brightness configuration response.

get.description: Retrieves the camera's current lighting level.

schema.description: The current normalized lighting level of the camera.

get.description: Retrieves the camera's current manual light configuration.
Retrieves the camera's current motion light configuration.
Retrieves the camera's current ambient light configuration.
Retrieves the camera's current general lighting configuration.
Retrieves the current audio recording setting.
Retrieves the current clip recording length.
Retrieves privacy mask overlay configuration.

get.summary: Get information about the wifi connection
get.description: Reads out wifi station and connection information (Signal strength, SSID, RegionCode)

Returns the configured local user name. Returns 404 if no local user is configured. Also returns 404 when the camera is not commissioned, as local user functionality is only available in commissioned state.

404.description: No local user or cam is not commissioned.

paired.description: Whether the camera is paired with a Smart Home system or not.

firmware_version.description: The current firmware version of the camera.

volume_level.description: Volume level. Returns -1 if no mapping fails.

noise_level.description: Current sound/noise level. Returns -1 on read failure.

privacyMasks.description: Parsed privacy masks with vertices only.

timeout.description: Timeout in seconds. Timeout parameter is optional and may not be included in body. Timeout will not be included in the response when privacy mode is enabled infinitely.

enable.description: Whether the mode is enabled or not.

timeout.description: Timeout in seconds. Timeout parameter is optional and may not be included in body. Timeout will not be included in the response when privacy mode is enabled infinitely.

enable.description: Whether the jingle is enabled or not.
Whether the status LED shall flash while streaming or not.
Whether the alarm is enabled or not.

arm.description: Whether the user intends to arm (true) or disarm (false) the intrusion system.

controlMode.description: The control mode of the intrusion system.

enable.description: Whether the alarm feature shall be enabled or not. When `true`, the alarm feature will actually be enabled on the camera after `alarmActivationDelay`.

alarmActivationDelay.description: The time in seconds it takes until the alarm feature is activated.

enablePreAlarm.description: Whether the pre alarm feature shall be enabled or not.

preAlarmDelay.description: The time in seconds from the recognition of an alarm event until the pre alarm is actually executed. The pre alarm will only be executed when _enablePreAlarm_ is `true`

alarmDelay.description: The time in seconds from the recognition of an alarm event until the alarm is actually executed.

alarmType.description: The type of the alarm that is active.

intrusionSystem.description: Whether the intrusion system is armed.

privacyMode.description: Whether the privacy mode is active.

CreateVirtualAlarmZone.description: Used to create virtual alarm zones. Does not contain an `id` field, because the id is determined by the camera when the zone is created.

points.description: Points describing the outer edges of a zone.

enabled.description: Whether detection is enabled at all.

sensitivity.description: The sensitivity of the virtual alarm recognition.

distance.description: The distance up to which radar events will be received for the outdoor virtual alarm recognition.

detectionMode.description: The detection mode. Influences how the underlying video analytics algorithm detects intrusions.

detectGlassBreak.description: Whether glass break detection is enabled.

detectFireAlarm.description: Whether fire alarm detection is enabled.

enable.description: Whether audio stream shall be recorded within a clip or not.

regionCode.description: Region code for wifi (regulatory rules for wifi behaviour).

linkQuality.description: percentage value of the link quality.

LocalUserName.description: Local user name if a local user is configured. Returns 404 if no local user is configured.

VirtualAlarmTriggerType.description: Determines for which type of event the zone shall care for.

VirtualAlarmMaskType.description: Determines the meaning of the specified zone to the underlying algorithm.

VirtualAlarmUseCase.description: Determines what shall happen when an event is detected in the zone.

VirtualAlarmPoint.description: A point in two-dimensional space for virtual alarms (e.g. zone or line).

x.description: Normalized x-coordinate of the zone's point.

y.description: Normalized y-coordinate of the zone's point.

ClipRecordingLength.description: Configuration for the clip recording length.

IconLedBrightnessConfig.description: Configuration for the icon led brightness.

r.description: Red component of the light color.

g.description: Green component of the light color.

b.description: Blue component of the light color.

brightness.description: Configuration for brightness of the light.

color.description: Configuration for color of the light.

whiteBalance.description: Configuration of the white balance of the light, ranging from -1 (cold white) to 1 (warm white).

ZoneMap.description: A map of the active radar zones. Each element represents a ring.

items.description: Each element represents a slice of a ring. 0=Zone deactivated, 1=Zone activated. The first element represents the inner ring, the last represents the outermost ring. First element of an array represent the zone to the left, last element the zone to the right.

ManualLightConfig.description: Configuration for the manual light feature.

MotionLightConfig.description: Configuration for the motion light feature.

enable.description: Whether motion light feature is enabled.

uptime.description: Number of seconds the light stays on after activation.

zone_map.description: Configuration for camera's motion light active zones.

sensitivity.description: The sensitivity of the motion light.

environmentalBrightnessThreshold.description: Determines at which light level motion light will trigger. Also used for ambient light when trigger is 'ENVIRONMENT'.

fadingEnabled.description: Whether fading is enabled on light mode switches.

AmbientLightConfig.description: Configuration for the ambient light feature.

enable.description: Whether ambient light feature is enabled.

trigger.description: The trigger type for ambient light

onTime.description: String formatted time to trigger ambient light ON

offTime.description: String formatted time to trigger ambient light OFF

DeactivatedWhenNotCommissioned.description: This endpoint will only be available, when the camera has been successfully commissioned.

InternalError.description: An internal error occurred while invoking the operation.
